name: Shimai x Saimin ~Zettai Fukujuu, Ore ga Zutto Ou-sama~
original_name: 姉妹X催眠 ～絶対服従、俺がずっと王様～
source:
The hero is a falling student who studies psychology at university.
However, he finds a method by which he can construct an absolute hierarchical relationship to the human brain using specific symbols.

[From [url=http://hentaiblog.org/2018/06/12/shimai-x-saimin-zettai-fukujuu-ore-ga-zutto-ou-sama/]Hentai Blog[/url]]

主人公是一名在大学学习心理学的堕落学生。
然而，他找到了一种方法，可以使用特定的符号与人脑构建绝对的等级关系。

[来自[url=http://hentaiblog.org/2018/06/12/shimai-x-saimin-zettai-fukujuu-ore-ga-zutto-ou-sama/]无尽博客[/url]]
